name: Anthropic Claude Mythos — Cracks HAWK Post-Quantum Sig in 60 Hours; 2^64 → 2^38; 200–800× Faster AES Attack
hook: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team published July 28 that Claude Mythos Preview found a real weakness in HAWK — a NIST post-quantum signature candidate that survived two years of expert human review — in just 60 hours. The attack cuts HAWK-256's effective key strength from ~2^64 to 2^38 operations. In the same run, Mythos produced a meet-in-the-middle improvement on 7-round AES-128 that runs 200–800× faster than the prior best-known attack. Neither result breaks production systems today (HAWK is not yet deployed; the AES variant is round-reduced), but the result validates AI as a compute line item in cryptanalysis. Simon Willison flagged it same-day; The Hacker News, CyberScoop, TechTimes, and The Quantum Insider all covered it July 28–29.

hook: Solves context loss, goal drift, and session amnesia with three markdown files — task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md — injected at the start of every Claude turn via lifecycle hooks.
